id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2724: "We called ourselves Arboria, the holy land, being the village nearest Yggdrasil. We can't use that name anymore.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2732: "Yggdrasil, the most precious thing to us, has fallen. I can't believe in anything anymore...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2743: "In Arboria, when seeing off the dead, everyone cuts a little hair and burns it in the fire.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2750: "Hair carries memories of time spent with the departed. We send the survivors' feelings to Heaven.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2764: "Yggdrasil has fallen and we have nothing to lean on... Everyone here has lost family.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2787: "Yggdrasil has fallen and we have nothing to lean on... Everyone here has lost family.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27c6: "Yggdrasil has fallen and we have nothing to lean on... Everyone here has lost family.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2774: "But those left behind must live. To carry on the hope the dead left behind into the future...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2796: "But those left behind must live. To carry on the hope the dead left behind into the future...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27d5: "But those left behind must live. To carry on the hope the dead left behind into the future...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a9: "Listen, Luminary. Leftover antidotal herbs, dried, can stand in for tea.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27b4: "A little bitter, but better than dead-leaf tea. Not even the Dark One can ruin my joy of tea in this shop!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27e9: "My, my, young man! You're breathtakingly handsome! The Luminary's companions are really something!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27f5: "If I were a few decades younger, I'd never leave you alone... Just kidding, ha ha ha!!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2807: "Luminary, thank you so much for coming to Arboria's feast despite your busy schedule.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2913: "I hate hard training. I want to be thanked with as little effort as possible, so I'm studying healing spells.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|291f: "With talent like Serena's, I guess studying isn't needed. Sigh... I'm so envious.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|292e: "I saw a mouse around here just now. After seeing that before bed, I can't sleep until I get rid of it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2939: "Sigh... If I'd skipped studying less, I could have learned Whack or Thwack.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2961: "I admire Veronica, so I'm studying magic. Controlling fire is cool, isn't it!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|296e: "I'm a magician's apprentice. Lately I can make a Frizz small enough to use for cooking.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|297f: "I lived with my sister, but she died shielding me from the shock when Yggdrasil fell...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|298f: "I regret that day every day. If I hadn't been outside then, maybe my sister would have lived...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ab: "My sister used herself as a shield to protect me from the shock that hit this area when Yggdrasil fell, and died.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29bc: "So I can't see Veronica's family's pain as someone else's.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29c4: "What did my sister and Veronica wish for as they died... Was it right that I survived...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29d2: "Ugh... Dark One... Don't take my sister away...! Sniff... sniff...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29df: "I have no family left. Now another survivor of the village is looking after me.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ff: "I have no family left. Now another survivor of the village is looking after me.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ed: "I can't forget my dead family, but I want to be able to call my new family Grandma properly.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a0d: "I can't forget my dead family, but I want to be able to call my new family Grandma properly.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a1e: "Hey... Grandma. Can I call you Grandma...? Mumble mumble...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a29: "I've never seen such a weird dance... but it looks really fun!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2acc: "My sister is so talented at magic, yet never studies seriously. She should follow the Luminary's example.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ada: "If you can't fight properly when it counts, it's your own life in danger...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aea: "Frizz... Bang... Crack... and the new spells that appeared recently...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2af3: "Whoa, Luminary! I'm embarrassed you're watching me study such basic spells.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aff: "My sister is careless, so I want to become a full magician soon so I can protect her when it counts.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b2c: "Hmm, you're the Luminary? You're quite different from the legendary Luminary in the tales.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b37: "You have a girl's face, and your hair is silkier than mine... I-it's kind of annoying...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b49: "Yggdrasil ended up like that, so the Luminary has had it rough too. I can tell just by looking at your face.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b55: "From seeing so much sorrow, I can somehow tell what a person carries just by their face...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b66: "Even with my eyes closed, I feel I'll fall asleep and never wake, so I can't fall asleep...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b70: "Even if I sleep, it's just nightmares. Since the day Yggdrasil fell, I haven't had one peaceful night...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b81: "After what happened to Veronica, will Serena keep traveling with the Luminary...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b8b: "...No, sorry. That's not for others to say.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b9c: "The twin sages are said to be reincarnations of Sage Senya.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bb2: "The twin sages are said to be reincarnations of Sage Senya.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba5: "With Veronica gone, Serena will bear that destiny alone...

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ca0: "The First Forest, which leads to Yggdrasil, is past this door along the mountain path.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cad: "The First Forest is dangerous and unexplored. Arboria's general store sells weapons and armor for adventure.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cbf: "Before heading to the First Forest, listen to the villagers and prepare well for the journey.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ccf: "Please defeat the one called Mordegon and protect the world's future! I pray for your fortune.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ce1: "The day Yggdrasil fell... I sensed something extraordinary had happened to {var:1}.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ced: "I haven't seen Veronica since then. Following Serena's guidance, please search southwest for the twin sages' other leaf.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d03: "The mythic scene in my dream, the sky island, is where you must go. Cetacea, the god's messenger, will lead you...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d16: "I'll search through every old text in the village about Cetacea. I'll report if I learn anything.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d24: "Well... you must be tired today. I've prepared an inn for you all, so please rest at the inn for now.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d39: "Oh... Luminary. It seems you couldn't sleep well.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d40: "The mythic scene in my dream must be where you should go. Cetacea, the god's messenger, will lead you...

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d85: "Well... you must be tired today. The night is cold, so return to the inn before you catch a cold.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d96: "{var:1}, search for the island floating in the sky. A new power to dispel the darkness must be there.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2da4: "{var:1}, please. Defeat Mordegon, the root of all evil, and avenge Veronica's regret!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f18: "Oh, Luminary... You've grown noble in looks in a short time.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f22: "The First Forest leading to Yggdrasil is past this door along the mountain path. I pray for your fortune.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f37: "Oh, Luminary. You seem to have gained the power to dispel the darkness.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f3f: "Now is the time to fulfill the Luminary's mission... I pray for your fortune.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f51: "The ornamental staff I gave you is the Sceptre of time that Sage Senya once used, now rusted.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f5e: "With a Fun-Sized Forge recipe, you could restore its former power.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f67: "I hear Senya's companion Nelsen was well versed in smithing. Please search for places that come to mind.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f7f: "I'm sick, and the doctor said I might not get better. But I remembered.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fad: "I'm sick, and the doctor said I might not get better. But I remembered.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f89: "Grandpa once told me about the legendary Flower of hope, which grants any wish when it blooms.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fb8: "Grandpa once told me about the legendary Flower of hope, which grants any wish when it blooms.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f96: "If you can go to the First Forest, talk to me again. I have a favor to ask you, big brother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc4: "But no one has ever gotten a Seed of hope, because a very rare monster called a Bloom of the underworld carries it...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fd2: "Big brother, you look really strong! Please, the favor of my life! Defeat a Bloom of the underworld and bring me a Seed of hope!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fe7: "...Sorry for asking the impossible. Don't mind it, big brother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff9: "Thank you, big brother! When the Flower of hope blooms, I'll wish for my illness to be cured!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3004: "The Bloom of the underworld with the Seed of hope is deep in the First Forest. But you can hardly ever meet it...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3040: "The Bloom of the underworld with the Seed of hope is deep in the First Forest. But you can hardly ever meet it...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3012: "Grandpa said defeating lots of monsters called Alraunes in the First Forest might make it appear.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304d: "Grandpa said defeating lots of monsters called Alraunes in the First Forest might make it appear.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|301d: "I know it'll be hard to get, but you're the only one I can rely on. Please get the Seed of hope, big brother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3059: "I know it'll be hard to get, but you're the only one I can rely on. Please get the Seed of hope, big brother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3037: "When the Flower of hope blooms, I'll wish for my illness to be cured!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|306d: "...Big brother, did you find the Seed of hope?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3073: "...It's okay. I'll wait until you bring it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3088: "Wow...! You kept your promise. Thank you, big brother.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3090: "They say the bigger the wish you make while growing the Flower of hope, the prettier it blooms.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|309b: "Will my flower bloom prettily...? No, it will. Because I have a dream!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30a6: "It's all thanks to you, big brother. Please accept my thanks.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30b6: "Cough... I'm a bit off today. But it's okay, big brother. It'll be cured when the Flower of hope blooms.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c3: "I can't wait. I hope it blooms soon! Come see it when it blooms, big brother! Cough cough.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30d4:
If only I had a
Seed of hope...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30f4: "This is the house where the twin sages Veronica and Serena grew up.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30fb: "I'm sure her parents will be glad to know the Luminary has come.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3113: "The Elder has a mysterious power. Before a great omen, he receives an oracle from Yggdrasil in his sleep.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3124: "In fact, he foretold the Luminary's birth in a dream.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|312d: "This is Elder Fanard's house. He said the Luminary may come in as you please.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3144: "Hohoho! Young one, are you ill? To live each day healthy and safe is the greatest happiness in life.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|316d: "Hohoho! Young one, are you ill? To live each day healthy and safe is the greatest happiness in life.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3153: "...You look healthy, good. If you go to the First Forest, tell me. I have a favor to ask.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|317c: "But health has no end! That's it! I'd die for health! My life exists for health!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3189: "I've given everything for health, and the ultimate answer I've reached is ancestor juice!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3195: "Young one... lend me your strength to complete the ancestor juice?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31a6: "What?! You have no interest in health?!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31ac: "I can't understand young people today. If you don't care to be healthy, what do you live for?!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31c4: "Hohoho. My eyes did not fail me. Now fetch the Red ancestor leaf, the ingredient of ancestor juice!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31d0: "The Red ancestor leaf is said to lie on the eastern side of the First Forest.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31da: "The Red ancestor leaf is said to lie on the mountain path at the heart of the First Forest, right beneath Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31eb: "The First Forest is sacred ground no one may enter, but the Luminary's ban is lifted. It's the will of the god of health!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31fb: "One Red ancestor leaf is enough. Bring it to me when you get it. I'm counting on you, fellow lover of health!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|322f: "One Red ancestor leaf is enough. Bring it to me when you get it. I'm counting on you, fellow lover of health!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3210: "Get the Red ancestor leaf, the ingredient of ancestor juice, on the eastern side of the First Forest!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|321d: "Get the Red ancestor leaf for the ancestor juice on the mountain path at the First Forest's heart, beneath Yggdrasil!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3242: "Ah, young one... Did you get the Red ancestor leaf?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|324c: "Sorry, but please hurry. My heart and soul are bursting with anticipation for health!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|326c: "This is it! Mix this Red ancestor leaf into a drink and the ancestor juice is complete! Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|327a: "Ugh, how awful! It tastes otherworldly! But it's working, it's working!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3285: "Hohoho! Power is surging! The blessing of the First Forest... no, Yggdrasil! It gushes from within my body!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3293: "I'm glad I asked you. This is the least I can do as thanks. Take it!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32a1: "Oh, it's you! Drinking the ancestor juice set my pursuit of health burning even brighter!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ae: "Health has no end! I'll do anything to be healthier from now on! Hohoho!!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32e3: "...Do you remember? The beautiful scenery of Erdrea we saw together that day.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3384: "...Do you remember? The beautiful scenery of Erdrea we saw together that day.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3413: "...Do you remember? The beautiful scenery of Erdrea we saw together that day.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32eb: "A sky so blue it seemed to draw me in. A sea of crimson dyed by the sunset. The leaves of Yggdrasil, full of life's radiance...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|341c: "A sky so blue it seemed to draw me in. A sea of crimson dyed by the sunset. The leaves of Yggdrasil, full of life's radiance...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32fb: "Everything we saw together is still burned into my heart.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|339d: "Everything we saw together is still burned into my heart.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|342c: "Everything we saw together is still burned into my heart.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3305: "Such a moving passage, isn't it. It was written in an old addressee-less letter in this village's collection.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3312: "I liked it so much I read it again and again until I memorized it.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|331c: "The letter seems to continue, so I looked for the rest, but it doesn't seem to be here...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3324: "By the way, you travel the world, right? If you could, find the rest of this letter and bring it to me?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3338: "I see. That's a shame. I'm sure it's a wonderful text full of the writer's feelings...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|334e: "Really?! Thank you! I heard the letter I read was tucked in a book from Arboria's collection.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|335b: "Some years ago a Gallopolis noble bought up old books from Arboria, so it probably got carried off among them.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33bb: "Some years ago a Gallopolis noble bought up old books from Arboria, so it probably got carried off among them.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3369: "First, go to Gallopolis and visit a house where a noble might live. Well then, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33c9: "First, go to Gallopolis and visit a house where a noble might live. Well then, I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|338d: "A sky so blue it seemed to draw me in. A sea of crimson dyed by the sunset. The leaves of Yggdrasil, full of life's radiance...

tm.「ここは 命の大樹に もっとも近い里だから\n 聖地ラムダと 名乗ってきたけどさ: "We called ourselves Arboria, the holy land, being the village nearest Yggdrasil. We can't use that name anymore.
tm.「私たちにとって いちばん大事な\n 命の大樹が 落ちてしまったんだもの。\n: "Yggdrasil, the most precious thing to us, has fallen. I can't believe in anything anymore...
tm.「この 聖地ラムダでは 故人を見送る時に\n みんな 少しずつ 髪を切って\n: "In Arboria, when seeing off the dead, everyone cuts a little hair and burns it in the fire.
tm.「髪には かつて 故人と一緒に過ごしてきた\n 思い出が 刻まれているからね……: "Hair carries memories of time spent with the departed. We send the survivors' feelings to Heaven.
tm.「もう 命の大樹は 落ちてしまったし\n 心の支えになるものは 何もない……。\: "Yggdrasil has fallen and we have nothing to lean on... Everyone here has lost family.
tm.「でも 残された者は 生きなきゃいけないんだ。\n 命を落とした人たちが 残して: "But those left behind must live. To carry on the hope the dead left behind into the future...
tm.「ちょいと 勇者さま 聞いておくれ。\n 余った どくけしそうを 干しておくと\: "Listen, Luminary. Leftover antidotal herbs, dried, can stand in for tea.
tm.「すこし 苦いけど 枯れ葉のお茶よりマシだわ。\n この店で お茶を飲む楽しみは: "A little bitter, but better than dead-leaf tea. Not even the Dark One can ruin my joy of tea in this shop!
tm.「まーまーまー お兄さんったら！\n ホレボレするほど 男前だわぁ！\n やっぱ: "My, my, young man! You're breathtakingly handsome! The Luminary's companions are really something!
tm.「おばちゃんが あと数十年 若かったら\n 絶対に ほっとかないんだけどねえ……: "If I were a few decades younger, I'd never leave you alone... Just kidding, ha ha ha!!
tm.「勇者さま 今日は お忙しい中\n ラムダの宴に来てくださって\n 本当に あり: "Luminary, thank you so much for coming to Arboria's feast despite your busy schedule.
tm.「もう 他の町には行かれました？\n 世界が平和になったことで 人々は\n 新た: "Have you been to other towns? With the world at peace, people have begun new beginnings.
tm.「新たな発見が あるかもしれませんし\n 一度 ロトゼタシア各地を回っても\n: "You might find new discoveries, so touring around Erdrea might be nice.
tm.「アタシ つらい修行とか 嫌いでさ～。\n なるべく ラクして 感謝されたいから: "I hate hard training. I want to be thanked with as little effort as possible, so I'm studying healing spells.
tm.「セーニャくらい 素質があると\n 勉強なんか 必要ないんでしょうね。\n はぁ: "With talent like Serena's, I guess studying isn't needed. Sigh... I'm so envious.
tm.「さっき この辺で ネズミを見たの。\n 寝る前に あんなの見ちゃったら\n 退: "I saw a mouse around here just now. After seeing that before bed, I can't sleep until I get rid of it.
tm.「はぁ……。\n こんなことなら 勉強をサボってないで\n ザキか ザラキを覚え: "Sigh... If I'd skipped studying less, I could have learned Whack or Thwack.
tm.「ぼく ベロニカさんに あこがれて\n 魔法を 勉強しているんです。\n 火を操: "I admire Veronica, so I'm studying magic. Controlling fire is cool, isn't it!
tm.「ぼく 魔法使いの見習いなんです。\n 料理に使えるくらいの 小さいメラなら\n: "I'm a magician's apprentice. Lately I can make a Frizz small enough to use for cooking.
tm.「ぼくは 姉さんと一緒に暮らしていたんですが\n 姉さんは 命の大樹が落ちた時の: "I lived with my sister, but she died shielding me from the shock when Yggdrasil fell...
tm.「毎日 あの日のことを 後悔してばかりです。\n ぼくが あの時 外にいなければ: "I regret that day every day. If I hadn't been outside then, maybe my sister would have lived...
tm.「ぼくの姉は 命の大樹が落ちた時に\n この辺りを襲った衝撃から ぼくを守るため: "My sister used herself as a shield to protect me from the shock that hit this area when Yggdrasil fell, and died.
tm.「ですから……ベロニカさんの家族のことは\n とても 他人事とは思えません。: "So I can't see Veronica's family's pain as someone else's.
tm.「姉さんも ベロニカさんも\n 何を願って 死んでいったのでしょう……。\n ぼ: "What did my sister and Veronica wish for as they died... Was it right that I survived...
tm.「うぅ……魔王……。\n お姉ちゃんを 連れていかないで……！\n ぐすっ……ぐ: "Ugh... Dark One... Don't take my sister away...! Sniff... sniff...
tm.「ぼくの家族は……もう 誰もいません。\n 今は 同じように 生き残った里の人が: "I have no family left. Now another survivor of the village is looking after me.
tm.「死んだ家族を 忘れることはできませんが\n 今は 新しい家族のことを おばあち: "I can't forget my dead family, but I want to be able to call my new family Grandma properly.
tm.「ねえ……おばあちゃん。\n おばあちゃんって呼んで いいかな……。\n むにゃ: "Hey... Grandma. Can I call you Grandma...? Mumble mumble...
tm.「こんな へんてこりんな踊り\n ボク 見たことなかったけど……。\n なんだか: "I've never seen such a weird dance... but it looks really fun!
tm.「ボクも 踊りたくなってきちゃった！\n おばあちゃんも 誘ったら\n 一緒に踊: "Now I want to dance too! If I invite Grandma, will she dance with me?
tm.「ぼくの姉さんは とても魔法の才能があるのに\n ちっとも マジメに勉強しようと: "My sister is so talented at magic, yet never studies seriously. She should follow the Luminary's example.
tm.「いざという時 ちゃんと戦えなかったら\n 危なくなるのは 自分の身なんですから: "If you can't fight properly when it counts, it's your own life in danger...
tm.「メラ……イオ……ヒャド……。\n それから 最近出てきた 新たな呪文……。: "Frizz... Bang... Crack... and the new spells that appeared recently...
tm.「わっ 勇者さま！\n こんな 初歩の呪文を勉強しているところ\n 恥ずかしいか: "Whoa, Luminary! I'm embarrassed you're watching me study such basic spells.
tm.「ぼくの姉さんは いいかげんな人ですから\n いざという時 ぼくが守れるように\: "My sister is careless, so I want to become a full magician soon so I can protect her when it counts.
tm.「ふうん あなたが 勇者さま？\n 伝承にあった 伝説の勇者とは\n ずいぶん: "Hmm, you're the Luminary? You're quite different from the legendary Luminary in the tales.
tm.「女の子みたいな カオしているし\n 髪も あたしより サラサラだし……。\n: "You have a girl's face, and your hair is silkier than mine... I-it's kind of annoying...
tm.「大樹が あんなことになって\n 勇者さまも ずいぶん 苦労したみたいね。\n: "Yggdrasil ended up like that, so the Luminary has had it rough too. I can tell just by looking at your face.
tm.「たくさん 悲しいことに触れてしまったせいで\n カオを見れば その人の背負って: "From seeing so much sorrow, I can somehow tell what a person carries just by their face...
tm.「こうして 目を閉じていても\n 眠ったまま 目覚めないような気がして\n なか: "Even with my eyes closed, I feel I'll fall asleep and never wake, so I can't fall asleep...
tm.「寝ても どうせ 悪夢ばかりだもの。\n 大樹が落ちた日から ずっと\n おだや: "Even if I sleep, it's just nightmares. Since the day Yggdrasil fell, I haven't had one peaceful night...
tm.「ベロニカが あんなことになったのに\n セーニャは これからも\n 勇者さまと: "After what happened to Veronica, will Serena keep traveling with the Luminary...
tm.「……いえ ごめんなさい。\n こればかりは 他人が\n クチをはさむことじゃな: "...No, sorry. That's not for others to say.
tm.「双賢の姉妹は 賢者セニカさまの\n 生まれ変わりと 言われています。: "The twin sages are said to be reincarnations of Sage Senya.
tm.「ベロニカが いない今\n セーニャは ひとりで \n その宿命を 背負っていく: "With Veronica gone, Serena will bear that destiny alone...
tm.「人前で 踊るなんて はしたないマネ\n 今までは 絶対に できなかったけど……: "Dancing in front of people is shameless. I never could before...
tm.「世界が平和になったのが うれしくって\n 勝手に 身体が動いちゃうんだもの！\: "But I'm so glad the world is at peace that my body moves on its own! Fun belongs to those who enjoy it!
tm.「命の大樹へ続く 始祖の森へは\n この扉を抜け 山道を進んだ先にあります。: "The First Forest, which leads to Yggdrasil, is past this door along the mountain path.
tm.「始祖の森は 前人未到の 危険な場所。\n ですが この聖地ラムダの よろず屋に: "The First Forest is dangerous and unexplored. Arboria's general store sells weapons and armor for adventure.
tm.「始祖の森へ 向かわれる前に\n 里の者の話に 耳をかたむけ 旅に出る準備を\n: "Before heading to the First Forest, listen to the villagers and prepare well for the journey.
tm.「どうか ウルノーガなる者を 討ち果たし\n 世界の未来を お守りくださいませ！: "Please defeat the one called Mordegon and protect the world's future! I pray for your fortune.
tm.「命の大樹が落ちた あの日……。\n {var:1}さまの身に ただならぬことが: "The day Yggdrasil fell... I sensed something extraordinary had happened to {var:1}.
tm.「あの時から ベロニカの姿は見ておりません。\n セーニャの導きにしたがい 南西: "I haven't seen Veronica since then. Following Serena's guidance, please search southwest for the twin sages' other leaf.
tm.「私が夢に見た 神話に似た光景……天の島こそ\n 勇者さまが 目指すべき地なので: "The mythic scene in my dream, the sky island, is where you must go. Cetacea, the god's messenger, will lead you...
tm.「このケトスについては 里じゅうの古文書を\n ひっくり返して お調べしておきま: "I'll search through every old text in the village about Cetacea. I'll report if I learn anything.
tm.「さあ……今日は もう お疲れでしょう。\n 皆さまのために 宿を用意しておりま: "Well... you must be tired today. I've prepared an inn for you all, so please rest at the inn for now.
tm.「おや……勇者さま。\n どうやら あまり眠れなかったようですね。: "Oh... Luminary. It seems you couldn't sleep well.
tm.「私が夢に見た 神話に似た光景は\n おそらく 勇者さまが目指すべき地……。\n: "The mythic scene in my dream must be where you should go. Cetacea, the god's messenger, will lead you...
tm.「ケトスについては 里じゅうの古文書を\n ひっくり返して お調べしておきましょ: "I'll search through every old text in the village about Cetacea. I'll report if I learn anything.
tm.「さあ……今日は もう お疲れでしょう。\n 夜は冷えますから カゼをひかないう: "Well... you must be tired today. The night is cold, so return to the inn before you catch a cold.
tm.「{var:1}さま。世界のどこかにある\n 天空に浮かぶ島を探すのです。きっと: "{var:1}, search for the island floating in the sky. A new power to dispel the darkness must be there.
tm.「{var:1}さま お願いいたします。\n 諸悪の根源たる 魔王ウルノーガを討: "{var:1}, please. Defeat Mordegon, the root of all evil, and avenge Veronica's regret!
tm.「勇者 {var:1}さま。\n あなたさまのおかげで 魔王は倒れ\n 世界に平: "Luminary {var:1}. Thanks to you the Dark One has fallen and peace has come to the world.
tm.「我ら一族も 勇者さまを守る使命を果たし\n 肩の荷が降りて安心したのでしょう。: "Our clan fulfilled its duty to protect the Luminary, and we feel relieved of a burden. We're more joyful than ever.
tm.「里の者の 笑顔を見たのは いつぶりか……。\n それも {var:1}さまのお: "When did I last see the villagers smile... That too is thanks to {var:1}. Please enjoy the feast with them.
tm.「おや 勇者さま……。\n すこし見ない間に ずいぶん\n りりしいカオ立ちに: "Oh, Luminary... You've grown noble in looks in a short time.
tm.「命の大樹へ続く 始祖の森へは\n こちらの扉を抜け 山道を進んだ先にあります。: "The First Forest leading to Yggdrasil is past this door along the mountain path. I pray for your fortune.
tm.「おお 勇者さま。\n 闇をはらうチカラを 手に入れたようですな。: "Oh, Luminary. You seem to have gained the power to dispel the darkness.
tm.「今こそ 勇者の使命を果たす時……。\n ご武運を お祈りしておりますぞ。: "Now is the time to fulfill the Luminary's mission... I pray for your fortune.
tm.「勇者さまに差しあげた 飾杖は\n かつて 賢者セニカさまが使っていた\n とき: "The ornamental staff I gave you is the Sceptre of time that Sage Senya once used, now rusted.
tm.「ふしぎな鍛冶の レシピがあれば\n きっと かつてのチカラを\n 取り戻すこと: "With a Fun-Sized Forge recipe, you could restore its former power.
tm.「セニカさまの仲間 ネルセンさまは\n 鍛冶にも くわしかったと聞きます。\n: "I hear Senya's companion Nelsen was well versed in smithing. Please search for places that come to mind.
tm.「私……病気でね お医者さんから\n 治らないかもって 言われてるんだ。\n で: "I'm sick, and the doctor said I might not get better. But I remembered.
tm.「おじいちゃんが 前に 話してくれた\n 花が咲けば どんな願いでも かなうって: "Grandpa once told me about the legendary Flower of hope, which grants any wish when it blooms.
tm.「もしも 始祖の森に 行けるようになったら\n また 話しかけてくれるかな。\n: "If you can go to the First Forest, talk to me again. I have a favor to ask you, big brother.
tm.「だけど きぼうの花のタネは 黄泉の花っていう\n すっごく めずらしい魔物が: "But no one has ever gotten a Seed of hope, because a very rare monster called a Bloom of the underworld carries it...
tm.「お兄ちゃんって すごく 強そうだよね？\n 一生のお願い！ 黄泉の花を やっつ: "Big brother, you look really strong! Please, the favor of my life! Defeat a Bloom of the underworld and bring me a Seed of hope!
tm.「……ごめんね ムリを言っちゃって。\n 気にしないで お兄ちゃん。: "...Sorry for asking the impossible. Don't mind it, big brother.
tm.「ありがとう お兄ちゃん！\n 私 きぼうの花が 咲いたら\n 病気が治りますよ: "Thank you, big brother! When the Flower of hope blooms, I'll wish for my illness to be cured!
tm.「きぼうのタネを持ってる 黄泉の花はね\n 始祖の森の いちばん奥の辺りにいるん: "The Bloom of the underworld with the Seed of hope is deep in the First Forest. But you can hardly ever meet it...
tm.「始祖の森にいる アラウネっていう魔物を\n たくさん やっつけると 姿を見せる: "Grandpa said defeating lots of monsters called Alraunes in the First Forest might make it appear.
tm.「手に入れるのは きっと 大変だと思うけど\n 私 お兄ちゃんしか 頼れる人がい: "I know it'll be hard to get, but you're the only one I can rely on. Please get the Seed of hope, big brother.
tm.「私 きぼうの花が 咲いたら\n 病気が治りますようにって お願いするの！: "When the Flower of hope blooms, I'll wish for my illness to be cured!
tm.「……お兄ちゃん\n きぼうのタネは 見つかった？: "...Big brother, did you find the Seed of hope?
tm.「……だいじょうぶ。\n お兄ちゃんが 持ってきてくれるまで 待つよ。: "...It's okay. I'll wait until you bring it.
tm.「わあ……！\n 約束 ちゃんと 守ってくれたんだね。\n ありがとう お兄ちゃ: "Wow...! You kept your promise. Thank you, big brother.
tm.「きぼうの花はね 育てているときに\n かけた願いが 大きければ 大きいほど\n: "They say the bigger the wish you make while growing the Flower of hope, the prettier it blooms.
tm.「私の花は きれいに咲くかな……？\n ううん 咲くに 決まってるわ。\n だっ: "Will my flower bloom prettily...? No, it will. Because I have a dream!
tm.「全部 お兄ちゃんのおかげよ。\n 私からの お礼の気持ち……受け取ってね。: "It's all thanks to you, big brother. Please accept my thanks.
tm.「ゴホッ……今日は ちょっと 調子悪いかな？\n でも だいじょうぶだよ お兄ち: "Cough... I'm a bit off today. But it's okay, big brother. It'll be cured when the Flower of hope blooms.
